prompts.name: musk_cover_up1
prompts.prompt: Upscale and restore image 1 into a sharp, high-resolution press photo. Keep EVERYTHING exactly the same: the same man, identical face, eyes, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin, wrinkles, hair, expression, gaze direction, suit, shirt, background blur, framing and lighting. Only remove blur, JPEG artifacts and noise and add natural fine detail. Do not beautify, do not change age or features, do not add or remove anything, no text, no logo, no watermark.
